stock.description: Homeland Interactive Technology Ltd. is a company based in the People's Republic of China that specializes in the creation, release, and management of mobile card and board games tailored for local audiences. Their offerings include popular titles such as mahjong and poker, as well as various casual games. The firm also undertakes the distribution of mobile games developed by other parties. Homeland Interactive Technology Ltd. was established in 2009, with its principal offices situated in Xiamen, PRC.
